Marta (CS): Heads-up — NovusMed just pushed back on the vendor risk form. Q12 (customer-managed keys) is blocking onboarding. They say embeddings must be BYOK and no caching of embeddings output. Deadline for renewal negotiation is Friday EOD.
Marco (Security): Short answer: Hosted API cannot do customer-managed keys today. Dedicated / Private can, but we need to validate key provenance and audit logs. Also need a dataflow diagram showing where embeddings land. :eyes:
Priya (Legal): If they're insisting on BYOK + no retention we should offer a DPA addendum that covers key custody, deletion attestations, and no-logs clause. I can draft a lean addendum but need exact technical constraints from Eng/Sec.
Sam (Eng): We have a supported path for KMS in Dedicated and Private. Implementation notes: set kms.provider and key_arn on the embeddings service, and you can set cache_ttl_seconds to 0 to disable prefix caching. Quick snippet below.
Sam (Eng): ```
service:
  embeddings:
    kms:
      provider: aws
      key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE
    cache_ttl_seconds: 0
```
Sam (Eng): Tradeoff: disabling cache increases per-request latency (~10-25% depending on batch size) and slightly higher cost. Also need security signoff for BYOK on Dedicated if customer demands stricter access controls.
Marta (CS): Perfect — Marco, can you list the exact log types we need from the KMS (e.g., key usage events, key rotation) so I can request roles/reads from NovusMed? They asked for an example policy.
Marco (Security): Ask them to grant a read-only CloudTrail view for key usage and provide KMS key policy that includes our service principal. Also request KMS admin contact for rotation windows. I'll draft a short checklist.
Priya (Legal): ETA on DPA addendum draft: I can have an initial version in 24 hours if Eng/Sec confirm the items to include. Marta, once I have technical bullet points I’ll send the customer-facing doc.
Marta (CS): I'm going to message the customer with: (1) config snippet, (2) list of logs/roles we need, (3) ask whether they require us to disable caching entirely or acceptable TTL. I'll push for answers by Thu morning.
account-bot: Renewal risk alert — NovusMed score dropped to 62. Flag: Security + Legal items outstanding.
Eli (AM): Thanks Marta — I'll join the customer call tomorrow and escalate if they insist on Hosted BYOK. We should also prepare fallback language for a phased approach (Dedicated first, Hosted later).
Marta (CS): Adding next steps in my calendar and scheduling 15-min sync with Priya + Marco + Sam. Will update thread after call. :thumbsup:
